elevate.move: Art-direct the frames as almanac plates: one season per photo (monsoon sky, scale band on tile, winter drain, finished pebble), each with a DM Mono folio and month caption and one warm grade, so the photo sequence reads as the year.

Make the first screen a real almanac cover: full-height cover plate on the right, a 12-month index with the current month lit, and three cover lines that are links to the season spreads, so the signature and the year are visible before any scroll.
